messages:
Romi (docs): Opened PR to refresh the rate-limit & quota examples to metering v2. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inc/docs/pull/5921 — can folks sanity-check HTTP body, SDK snippet, and grafana link?
Diego (eng): Quick check: examples must prefer the JSON meter payload. If you show a header, use X-Redwood-Usage and label it as fallback.
Romi (docs): Will swap to JSON canonical + add header fallback note. Current HTTP sample is minimal JSON and marked as "json".
Priya (product): Update the sample tier bands in the explanatory calc to reflect the recent pricing change (Standard 75k-600k). Add parenthetical: (see pricing page for live bands).
Kei (devex): SDK snippet should use the v3 call metering.submit({ customerId, items }). Keep it 2 lines so it's copy-paste friendly. Also prefer ISO timestamps.
Romi (docs): Updated SDK example to: ```js
await metering.submit({ customerId: 'acct_321', items: [{ 'generation.tokens': 140000 }] })
``` and HTTP to: ```json
{
  "customer_id": "acct_321",
  "usage": { "generation.tokens": 140000 },
  "timestamp": "2026-03-23T18:00:00Z"
}
```
Diego (eng): Payload looks good. Two tiny nits: remove trailing comma if present and point grafana to https://grafana.redwood/d/usage/overview?panelId=41. Add alt text for the screenshot.
Romi (docs): Fixed commas and swapped the grafana link. Added alt: "Daily metered tokens by tier".
Priya (product): Please add a short migration blurb: "If you previously used X-Usage-Plan header, migrate to JSON metering or X-Redwood-Usage header; token->tier math unchanged."
Romi (docs): Added migration note and a one-line old-vs-new snippet. Pushing now.
preview-bot: Preview build created for PR 5921  https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood/5921 (build 907).
Diego (eng): LGTM. Priya?
Priya (product): Approved. Merge in ~10m unless objections. Thanks! :tada:
